tools.name: cari_paket
tools.description: Search Pakeesim's live catalogue of prepaid travel data eSIMs (prices in IDR, live sale prices and availability). Use it when the user asks for eSIM or travel data plans for a destination. `tujuan` is free text in any language: a country, city or region, optionally with days and data ("Japan 7 days

tools.name: detail_paket
tools.description: Full details of one plan by slug: live price and sale end, data, validity, every covered country, network, description, device requirements and links to installation and refund policy.

tools.name: promo_berjalan
tools.description: Sales running right now (flash sales and discounts), grouped by data/validity, with sale price, normal price, percent saved, start and end time and which destinations they apply to.

tools.name: hitung_harga
tools.description: Exact price breakdown before ordering, without creating an order: unit price (with any running sale), subtotal for the quantity, promo code check and discount, total to pay, and whether the plan can be ordered in that quantity.

tools.name: cek_perangkat
tools.description: Checks a phone/tablet model against Pakeesim's eSIM device reference list (e.g. "iPhone 13", "Galaxy S23", "Redmi Note 13") and returns a verdict, notes for that brand, and how the user can confirm on the device itself. It is a reference, not a guarantee: support depends on the variant and market.

tools.name: info_checkout
tools.description: Returns the active online payment methods (use `id` as `metodePembayaran`; an empty list means online payment is temporarily unavailable), the exact consent statement and device requirements the user must accept, the maximum quantity and the order expiry.

tools.name: buat_pesanan
tools.description: Creates an order for the user and emails them the order link. Only call this after the user chose the plan and explicitly confirmed this statement: "I have checked: my phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked (SIM Lock). tools.name: cek_pesanan
tools.description: Returns an order's status, the next step, payment details, and — once delivered — the eSIM profiles (LPA QR payload, SM-DP+ address, activation code).
